```xml
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="org" name="Organisation" processRef="org-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="org-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="org-lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="hr" name="HR clerk">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>vacancy_reported</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>create_job_description</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confusion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ask_department</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit_for_consideration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>correct_description</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit_again</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>post_job</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>job_posted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="department" name="Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review_job_description</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>request_correction</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="vacancy_reported" name="Vacancy reported" />

    <bpmn:task id="create_job_description" name="Create job description" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="confusion" name="Confusion in message?" default="to_submit" />
    <bpmn:task id="ask_department" name="Ask Department again" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit_for_consideration" name="Submit job description for consideration" />

    <bpmn:task id="review_job_description" name="Review job description" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="approved" name="Job description approved?" default="to_request_correction" />
    <bpmn:task id="request_correction" name="Request correction" />

    <bpmn:task id="correct_description" name="Correct job description" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit_again" name="Submit job description for consideration" />

    <bpmn:task id="post_job" name="Post job" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="job_posted" name="Job posted" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="vacancy_reported" targetRef="create_job_description" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="create_job_description" targetRef="confusion" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_to_ask" name="yes" sourceRef="confusion" targetRef="ask_department" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="to_submit" name="no" sourceRef="confusion" targetRef="submit_for_consideration" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_ask_create" sourceRef="ask_department" targetRef="create_job_description" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_submit_review" sourceRef="submit_for_consideration" targetRef="review_job_description" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_review_gw" sourceRef="review_job_description" targetRef="approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_approved_post" name="yes" sourceRef="approved" targetRef="post_job" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="to_request_correction" name="no" sourceRef="approved" targetRef="request_correction" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_request_correct" sourceRef="request_correction" targetRef="correct_description" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_correct_submit" sourceRef="correct_description" targetRef="submit_again" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_submit_again_review" sourceRef="submit_again" targetRef="review_job_description" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f_post_end" sourceRef="post_job" targetRef="job_posted" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```
